title: Negros bishop leads push for antidynasty campaign
summary: BACOLOD CITY, NEGROS OCCIDENTAL, Philippines — The Diocese of San Carlos in Negros Occidental province is seeking to enliven efforts to legislate a measure against dynastic control of political power…

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY, NEGROS OCCIDENTAL, Philippines — The Diocese of San Carlos in Negros Occidental province is seeking to enliven efforts to legislate a measure against dynastic control of political power in the country, calling on clergy, Catholic schools, and lay organizations to intensify the collection of signatures for a people’s campaign to stop political dynasties.
